activity.notes: ATLAS uses 211 as the map-level start of the Liu Bei/Shu Han territorial interval, consistent with Liu Bei and Guan Yu already in Production; Zhang Fei's service to Liu Bei began earlier. The Sanguozhi records his participation in the Yi Province conquest, later senior military appointments, promotion in 221, and death that year.
